status: planned -- repo (producer + hand DDL + tests) LEADS live Glue by this one column; apply is an ORCHESTRATOR AWS step
why: The table had NO PIT-anchorable column at all. Measured 2026-08-18 with pyarrow over EVERY canonical object (s3://leviathan-dev-shahem-001/silver/fnc_colombia/area_department/, _shadow/_manifests excluded): 24 parquet objects, 492 rows, 23 departments, years 2002..2025, ONE body schema = [leviathan_slug, country, department, department_raw, year, area_ha, source]. No date, no month, no vintage, no ingest stamp -- `year` is the CROP/calendar year, not a knowledge date. So leviathan.graphrag.numbers.query._guard had no branch it could take: knowledge_col() returned None for vintage|ingest|data_date (raise 'table silver_fnc_colombia_area_department has no knowledge/date column to anchor the as-of guard'), and the year_month branch was unreachable because month_col does not exist. Anchoring on the int `year` was REJECTED, not deferred: it would CAST a PROJECTED partition column (the Jul-2026 LIST-storm non-sargable pattern) and it would LEAK, making year Y citable from 1 January of year Y.
mechanism: Direct ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMNS (Athena/Hive), the WIRING_WAVE1 precedent (silver_conab_coffee.survey_release_date, silver_sagis_weekly_exports.week_ending_date) and the same shape as the two sibling D-LD Tranche 2 artifacts in this directory. ingest_date is APPENDED LAST (catalog position 7, after `source`) so live-Glue column order stays base-6 + this one additive tail -- byte-consistent with sql/athena/ddl/silver_fnc_colombia_area_department.sql and with the producer's AREA_OUTPUT_COLUMNS tail. leviathan.silver.ddl.diff_structured and jobs/utils/validate_athena_ddl_drift.py compare columns IN ORDER, so a mid-list insert would have forced a full re-register; the append keeps this a one-liner. The two projected partition keys (commodity string, year int) and every projection TBLPROPERTY are UNTOUCHED -- this is not a DROP+CREATE and must never become one (INV-3).
glue_call: glue.update_table(DatabaseName='leviathan_dev', TableInput=<desired silver_fnc_colombia_area_department with the 7th column appended>)  # additive; equivalently the ALTER above
derivation: NOT derived -- CARRIED. transforms/raw_to_bronze/fnc_excel.extract_fnc_excel stamps df['ingest_date'] onto every bronze series; transforms/bronze_to_silver/fnc_colombia.AREA_OUTPUT_COLUMNS simply dropped it at the final column selection. Coverage measured 2026-08-18 on the canonical bronze object bronze/production/source=fnc_excel/series=area_departamento/part-000.parquet: 492/492 rows carry a stamp, ONE distinct value '2026-06-02', alongside source_file 'Precios-area-y-produccion-de-cafe-2026-1.xlsx'. Because the silver task re-reads that existing bronze object, the re-run PRESERVES the true stamp -- do NOT re-run the raw->bronze fetch to land this column, that would overwrite 2026-06-02 with today.
semantics: knowledge_semantics: ingest (the silver_production idiom), publication_lag_days: null. FNC republishes the whole workbook and this producer OVERWRITES (F010 write_mode: overwrite, vintage_retention: latest-only), so there is exactly one non-revising edition -- no vintage to collapse and no publication lag to shift. STATED COST: an as-of EARLIER than the snapshot's ingest_date returns ZERO rows. That is fail-CLOSED (it can never leak) but it means the table is a current-structure surface, not a backtest surface.
sequencing_note: 1) apply this ALTER; 2) re-run ONLY the bronze->silver producer -- python jobs/batch/fnc_colombia_silver_task.py --publish-mode canonical --force-overwrite true (492 rows, 24 objects, ~119 KB, signed-approval publish guard as usual); 3) append {"name": "ingest_date", "type": "string"} to glue.nonpartition_columns in reports/silver_readiness/20260712_p65impl/tables/silver_fnc_colombia_area_department.json (the frozen R0 baseline the F010 generator reads) -- WITHOUT this, tests/unit/silver/test_ddl_generation.py::test_generated_matches_live_glue_for_every_table fires; 4) python scripts/silver/gen_registry_from_baseline.py  (configs/silver/tables/silver_fnc_colombia_area_department.yaml goes 6 -> 7 physical_columns, fingerprint glue_nonpartition_cols 6->7 and physical_parquet_cols 7->8, both hashes change); 5) python scripts/silver/generate_ddls_from_registry.py --write  (refreshes sql/athena/ddl_generated/silver_fnc_colombia_area_department.sql, which still shows the pre-additive 6 columns until then). ORDER NOTE, and it differs from the flat sibling tables: this producer does NOT route through leviathan.silver.flat_producer.encode_parquet -- it is a PROJECTED per-(commodity, year) write through ShadowPublisher with ValidationHooks(min_rows=1) and no expected_fingerprint, so there is NO contract-column encode gate. Step 2 therefore does not have to wait for steps 3-5; only the drift tripwires do.
rollback_note: ALTER TABLE leviathan_dev.silver_fnc_colombia_area_department REPLACE COLUMNS (...the 6 pre-additive columns...) to drop ingest_date from the catalog; the stored parquet is unaffected either way and the column is a timing stamp only -- it never touches a measured value (area_ha). The numbers card is not live until D-LD lands it in configs/graphrag/numbers/tables.yaml, so there is no serving surface to disable; after that, GRAPHRAG_NUMBERS_DISABLE=silver_fnc_colombia_area_department is the config-only, fail-closed kill.
